messages:
Tariq: quick PSA — someone keeps swiping the office cookies. i coded a tiny LLM to draft the notes for my passive-aggressive sticky notes. meet 'Snack Sheriff' :sheriff: 
Lina: omg this is peak 2026. does it do Whole-Office Manifestos or just tiny sticky notes? :laughing:
Tariq: both. it has templates: polite, stern, forensic, and poetic. sample output: "Dear thief, these were artisanal. please return or face my unending disappointment."
Devon: can it escalate? like step 1: sticky note, step 2: emoji roast in #random, step 3: forensic spreadsheet? :popcorn:
Tariq: yup, escalation policy configurable. i made a little prompt mapping: ```policy: 1-2 thefts -> polite, 3+ -> stern DM, 5+ -> public haiku```
Priya: public haiku??? now this is worth the repo star. also, include a celebration template for when someone actually labels their food. must be enthusiastic. :tada:
Maya: name ideas: Snack Sheriff, Dessert Diplomat, Cookie Constable, LLMediary. my vote: Dessert Diplomat. sounds diplomatic and slightly smug.
Lina: Dessert Diplomat wins. can it include a tiny ascii badge when someone cops to it? like (•‿•) COOKIE CONFESSOR?
Devon: ops-bot: please ensure the bot doesn't leak personal data if someone confesses in DMs. also, no auto-posts at 3am. we have partners in europe.
ops-bot: noted. auto-post windows: 9:00-17:00 local. DMs scanned only for consented confessions. data retention: 7 days.
Priya: can we add a 'kudos cookie' flow? if someone brings snacks, the bot posts a GIF + a tiny thread of thanks so we don't spam #kudos.
Tariq: already there. it picks a GIF from the 'snack-thanks' pack and quotes the donor. snippet: ```assistant: thank you + recommended coffee pairing + emoji```
Maya: poll time: should Dessert Diplomat be polite-by-default or dramatic-by-default? react with :heart: for polite, :fire: for dramatic.
Lina: :heart:
Devon: :fire: (but allow polite mode for new hires)
Priya: :heart: 
Tariq: soft roll-out. i'll post a demo sticky-note image and the prompt templates tomorrow. whoever helps test gets first dibs on the new cookie box.
Maya: also someone bought donuts today? huge thanks to whoever that was 36a :heart_eyes:
Lina: that was Sam from sales. he left a sticky that said 'not my problem, take what you want'. peak man.
Devon: immortalize that sticky in the bot templates? please.
Tariq: final: will not enable automatic DMs unless we have 2/3 human opt-in. ops-bot, confirm requirements.
ops-bot: confirmed. human guardrails required: 2 approvers from Admin, Security, or People Ops.
Priya: closing — if Dessert Diplomat ever publicly shames someone, they owe cookies for a week. agreed? :cookie:
All: agreed.
